# David Grimsley Full Agent Context

> Navigation context for David Grimsley's portfolio, services, public developer tools, and production apps.

Canonical site: `https://davidjgrimsley.com`. Start with [llms.txt](/llms.txt) for the short directory. This site documents projects and services; it does not grant an agent permission to contact David, submit forms, or call authenticated APIs.

## Portfolio

The [portfolio](/portfolio) groups [mobile apps](/portfolio/mobile-apps), [websites](/portfolio/website-development), [games](/portfolio/game-design), and [software](/portfolio/software-development). Each category has a concise guide under `/guides/` and links to individual project pages. Use the human pages for current screenshots, details, and outbound links.

## Services and contact

The [services page](/services) explains available work and links to project inquiry forms. The [contact page](/contact) has a resume link and general form. See [services guide](/guides/services.md) and [contact guide](/guides/contact.md) for low-noise orientation.

## Public tools and apps

- [API directory](/public-facing/api) · [guide](/guides/apis.md)
- [MCP directory](/public-facing/mcp) · [guide](/guides/mcp.md)
- [Production apps](/public-facing/production) · [guide](/guides/production-apps.md)

The MCP directory includes app-development and Pokémon servers. The production page currently features PokePages. Each product's page and repository provide its current details.

## Quantum API

Quantum API is one published API. Its [human page](/public-facing/api/quantum) and [Markdown guide](/public-facing/api/quantum.md) cover the integration starting point. The live OpenAPI and endpoint directory linked there are the sources for exact current schemas; do not infer endpoint names or authentication behavior from this site overview.

Plugin and package guides:

- [Unreal Plugin](/public-facing/api/quantum/ue-plugin.md)
- [TypeScript SDK](/public-facing/api/quantum/typescript-sdk.md)
- [Python SDK](/public-facing/api/quantum/python-sdk.md)
- [Godot Addon](/public-facing/api/quantum/godot-addon.md)
- [Unity Package](/public-facing/api/quantum/unity-package.md)

Authentication and version details may change. Read the current product documentation before integrating. Never expose credentials, tokens, API keys, or private service state.

## Discovery

Landing pages advertise their corresponding Markdown guide with `rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"` and point to `/llms.txt` with `rel="describedby"`. [robots.txt](/robots.txt) and [sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml) describe public crawling and canonical HTML pages.
